items.text: Release 1. This is the first release of this qualification in the UEG Gas Industry Training Package.
There are no entry requirements for this qualification

cells.text: A total of 12 units of competency comprising:
4 gas elective units from Group A, plus
2 imported elective units from Group B, and

the remaining 2 elective units may be selected from Group A or Group B or with appropriate contextualisation from a qualification in this or any endorsed Training Package, provided selected units contribute to the vocational outcome of the qualification.
Apply environmental policies and procedures in the gas supply industry
Prepare to work in the gas industry
Carry out basic work activities in a gas industry work environment
Apply safe working practices in the gas supply industry
Assist with the construction and laying of gas distribution mains
Assist with the construction, laying and connection of gas distribution services to mains
Establish right of way access and maintain transmission pipeline easement
Fill by weight industrial gas cylinders
First on site response to gas pipeline emergencies
Inspect, test and maintain gas cylinders
Monitor and control the transfer of bulk industrial gas
Use a portable detector to locate a combustible gas escape
Pressure test residential and small commercial gas installations
Locate, prove and protect utility assets
Work in proximity of transmission pipeline construction plant and equipment
First response to a gas facility event
Disconnect and reconnect small capacity gas meters
Process meter reading information using appropriate technology
Apply safety practices, procedures, and compliance standards for handling hydrogen gas
Prepare to work safely in the construction industry
ProvideFirstAid in remote or isolated site
Work in accordance with an issued permit
Undertake first response to fire incidents
Enter and work in confined spaces
Store and handle dangerous goods and hazardous substances
Apply safe procedures when handling/transporting dangerous goods or explosives
Work safely in the vicinity of live electrical apparatus as a non-electrical worker

items.text: This qualification supersedes and is equivalent to UEG20121 Certificate II in Gas Supply Industry Operations
Companion Volume Implementation Guides are found in VETNet - https://vetnet.gov.au/Pages/TrainingDocs.aspx?q=6a6c032e-ffcb-4f3d-8063-415efbd261e8
